name: 赛博霓虹
label: 赛博霓虹
palette: 电蓝、洋红、酸性绿与湿润黑色，冷暖互撞
lighting: volumetric neon, rim lights, reflective wet surfaces, localized haze only where motivated
optics: 24mm wide environmental lens, 50mm subject inserts, anamorphic flare used sparingly
composition: 多层城市深度、透明材质和反射构成画面，主体轮廓必须清晰
camera_motion: slow parallax dolly, vertical crane through signage layers, controlled rack focus
style_instructions: High-end cyberpunk live-action production frame, believable near-future infrastructure, dense layered depth, practical materials, cinematic clarity.
avoid_instructions: No random gibberish text, no cluttered UI overlay, no fantasy medieval props, no oversharpened game screenshot, no watermark.

video.video_prompt: Animate parallax through layered signage and reflections; maintain a single coherent light direction and clear subject silhouette.
